title: 淡水老街 景點- (VRbyby 全國廟宇網)
description:
Tamsui Riverside Promenade

A tranquil riverside walkway in Tamsui Old Street features colorful wooden boats gently bobbing on the water beside a stone-paved path. Trees line the promenade, providing shade for visitors who wander past small shops and food stalls. A red circular sign bearing the character “停” stands near a bench where a visitor sits, adding a touch of local signage to the scene.

Tamsui Old Street, once called Huwei, stretches along Zhongzheng Road beside the MRT Tamsui Station plaza and follows the Tamsui River’s edge. Known for its historic architecture and famous local snacks—iron eggs, shrimp rolls, A-gei, fish crisps, and grilled squid—the area welcomes tourists year-round. The calm water, overcast sky, and leisurely pace of pedestrians capture the laid-back charm of this northern Taiwan landmark.
